summary: Frontend-only regression on iter-6 (390x844, guest). (2) Home — home-explore-tile renders after completing onboarding: screenshot confirms EXPLORE label + 'Every category is a discovery' subline + 3D question-mark artwork (home-explore-art via CategoryArtMark categoryId='all') anchored right, sitting mostly INSIDE the 92px glass tile with only the top ~16px poking out (matches HomeExploreTile: art size 106, top:0 on wrapper with exploreWrap paddingTop:16 → art visually starts 16px above the glass tile). Home also shows home-credits '4', tab bar, story card. (3) Topics/Discover tab — grid renders EXPLORE (chip-all) with 3D icon and all 12 category chips (Science, Space, Technology, Nature, Animals, History, Psychology, Human Body, Culture, Money & Economics, Art & Design, Geography & Travel) all with 3D icons; ESPLORA icon consistently placed with top poking out. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none. React Native web console warnings (non-blocking): 'textShadow*' props deprecated (use 'textShadow'), 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents)', and Reanimated: 'Selected easing is not currently supported on web. Using linear easing instead.' (fires for Easing.bezier(0.3,0,0.1,1) in story-morph + Easing.inOut(cubic) in deep-dive autofocus — on WEB the SCROLL_MS=864 lens still applies but with linear easing; on native it uses the intended bezier).

integration_issues.flow: Home → morph → deep-dive open/close and reader ending (remember-card, next-discovery, ending-home/read-btn)
integration_issues.issue: Automated navigation from onboarding-continue into the deep-dive did not complete within this session's timing window (page.url stayed at /onboarding when the *-open probe ran, even though the Home screenshot captured a rendered Home mid-run). ending-related testIDs (deep-dive-ending, remember-card, summary-card, like-button, bookmark-button, share-story, next-discovery, next-discovery-title, next-story, next-info-grid, ending-home-btn, ending-read-btn) were therefore NOT exercised end-to-end in playwright this iteration. Static code review of reader-ending.tsx confirms all these testIDs are wired correctly, remember-card is a glass container (rememberCard style + LinearGradient + inset shadow + rememberAccent bar), a divider is rendered before next-discovery (LinearGradient height:1), eyebrowLarge uses fontSize:17 letterSpacing:2.2 (bigger title), nextCard is flexGrow:1 minHeight:190 and holds only StoryHero+gradient+HighlightedTitle (NO arrow orb inside — arrow-forward icon lives on the separate ending-read-btn primary CTA below), and StoryInfoGrid inline is used (3D icons, testID next-info-grid). ending-home-btn calls onBackPress and ending-read-btn calls onNext.

react_native_issues.issue: Reanimated logs 'Selected easing is not currently supported on web. Using linear easing instead.' for Easing.bezier(0.3,0,0.1,1) (MORPH_EASING) and Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic) (SCROLL_EASING). On web the morph and chapter-autofocus therefore fall back to linear timing; on native the intended curves apply. Not blocking, but worth noting since the review points out the transition/scroll should feel smooth. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/story-morph.tsx:35, /app/frontend/app/deep-dive/[id].tsx:54
'textShadow*' style props deprecated (use 'textShadow'); 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking but noisy on the reader path.

context_for_next_testing_agent: App URL: https://pause-app-19.preview.emergentagent.com — flow: onboarding-profile-continue → (locale-dependent modes step, one or two onboarding-continue clicks) → topics step (chip-all + chip-<id>) → onboarding-continue → Home. Timing tips: after onboarding-continue give at least 2500ms before probing home-explore-tile (Reanimated + morph host warm-up), and after tapping a *-open card the deep-dive scroll may need 2500ms before deep-dive-scroll is present (morph runs 680ms + fade). To reach the ending, prefer scrolling by finding the [data-testid="deep-dive-page-end"] node and calling element.scrollIntoView({behavior:'instant',block:'start'}) on it; the reader disables free scroll (scrollEnabled=false) so mouse wheel or PageDown must be routed through the wheel listener on the wrapper (dispatch a WheelEvent on the wrap ref). To verify no arrow orb inside next-story, query [data-testid="next-story"] and ensure no descendant with width==34 && height==34 (GlowOrb size=34) exists; ending-home-btn is the leftmost Pressable of nextCtas and ending-read-btn is the primary cyan CTA on the right.
